about: Lot 314 (the third bug hunt, BUG-84 a): a force-posture toward the state the posture is in changes nothing — its decay timers included. A signed force to ALERTED; 59 minutes later a second one, to the same ALERTED: no transition, the timers as they were; ALERTED decays to OBSERVING an hour after the first. A force to ENGAGED; 23 h 59 later a second one: ENGAGED decays to ALERTED 24 hours after the first. On main the second force re-armed the decay each time (one hour more of ALERTED, a day more of ENGAGED).
